item.title: Billionaire CEO shifts from office oversight to hybrid work, urging trust in employees

item.title: Bond market signals on Congress, national debt, middle class and America's path forward
item.description: The only real solution is putting fiscal policy on a sustainable path, but on taxes, there is limited room to maneuver.

item.title: MacKenzie Scott's first novel in 13 years called 'baffling' by critics
item.description: The billionaire philanthropist, who has donated $26 billion, released Last Days in Two Nations for free on Substack, not Amazon.

item.title: African entrepreneurs need capital and business support
item.description: Young African entrepreneurs require early funding, practical assistance, and market access.
